stem:
When three squares are joined at their vertices to form a right triangle, the combined area of the two smaller squares is the same as the area of the largest square.

Which three squares do NOT support this statement?
visual_elements: 3 cm square, 4 cm square, 25 cm² square in option F
5 cm square, 12 cm square, 13 cm square in option G
9 cm square, 144 cm² square, 21 cm square in option H
6 cm square, 64 cm² square, 100 cm² square in option J
